26729.description:
Summary
The
Employee Services Supervisor
oversees daily HR support operations and ensures smooth coordination of employee-related services, including benefits administration, timekeeping, and employee inquiries. This role requires strong ERP knowledge to monitor and review employee data, synchronize working hours with team members, and provide timely reports to management.
This position requires occasional travel (3-4 times per year) for training, HR meetings, and company-wide events.
Duties and Responsibilities
Supervise and coordinate remote employee services, ensuring efficient HR operations.
Monitor and review employee records, attendance, and payroll entries within the ERP system to ensure accuracy.
Ensure compliance with company policies, labor laws, and ISO standards.
Sync up working hours with remote team members to ensure seamless collaboration and availability.
Act as the primary point of contact for remote employees regarding HR policies, payroll queries, and workplace concerns.
Conduct virtual onboarding sessions and assist new hires with ERP system access and company policy understanding.
Prepare and submit timely reports on employee services performance, attendance trends, and HR compliance.
Support engagement initiatives such as online training, wellness programs, and performance evaluations.
Collaborate with HR leadership and IT teams to ensure remote employees have access to necessary HR tools and systems.
Travel for training, ERP system upgrades, and HR strategy meetings (3-4 times per year).
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in HR services, employee relations, or HR administration.
In-depth knowledge of ERP systems (Odoo, SAP, Oracle, or similar) with hands-on experience managing HR modules.
Ability to monitor, review, and analyze employee records and HR data within the ERP system.
Strong communication skills with the ability to provide effective remote employee support.
Ability to sync up working hours across different time zones and ensure smooth coordination with the team.
Experience in HRIS, payroll management, and digital employee engagement tools.
Strong attention to detail and ability to detect errors in employee records.
Ability to generate timely reports and provide data-driven insights to management.
Willingness to travel for training and strategic HR meetings.

26707.description:
Job Type:
Fixed Term Contract
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
The Safety Officer for Projects is responsible for ensuring that all safety regulations and procedures are followed during the execution of the stage 3 expansion for Kainantu Gold Mine. This role is a crucial role in preventing accidents and incidents, protecting the health and safety of employees, contractors and maintaining compliance with Papua New Guinea’s safety laws and regulations.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensuring the continuous improvement of, safety inspections, safety training and compliance.
Maintain a safe work environment for all K92 employees, visitors and contractors through audits, inspections, and training.
Maintain the efficiency and cost-effective management of safety in the workplace and project site.
Ensure all incidents are fully investigated and recorded within the site safety data base in a timely and accurate manner.
Conduct safety training programs and initiative.
Conduct scheduled, weekly, monthly safety audits and checks project wide
Collate and submit weekly and monthly reports to Project Director and Operational GM.
Attend site wide weekly and monthly safety meetings.
Ensuring that the camp and project sites safety regulations are observed by all K92 employees including contractors,
Provide safety induction to new intakes, casuals, contractors, and visitors to site.
To ensure the safety rules and other policies of the camp and mine site are observed and report any suspicious activities.
About You
To be considered for this position, candidates must have 10 years minimum Safety work experience in an extractive industry or heavy construction environment. In addition to this, candidates should also (ideally) be able to demonstrate some or all the following.
Appropriate Safety Officer qualifications (Cert IV OHS minimum).
Significant experience with auditing, incident reporting.
Incident investigation training (preferably ICAM)
Well versed with safety systems that deals with compliance records and reports.
Excellent oral and written communications skills.
Very good end user of MS Office Suite: Word, Excel and Outlook.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

Reporting: Be able to keep daily logs of areas sprayed, chemicals used, and types of habitats found.

A hardworking attitude and the ability to work outdoors in various environments.

27154.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
As an Analyst – End User Computing, you will play a key role in ensuring the seamless operation, reliability, and security of end-user technology across site. You will support the implementation, maintenance, and optimisation of professional applications and devices, while enhancing digital services through user engagement and continuous improvement.
As part of our team, you will
Provide technical support and maintenance for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, and video conferencing systems.
Ensure the reliable operation of IT equipment, including printers, audio-visual systems, and meeting room technologies.
Troubleshoot and resolve technology issues promptly to deliver a high level of customer satisfaction.
Support end-users with professional applications, ensuring a positive and efficient user experience.
Monitor and maintain the security and integrity of end-user devices and data.
Configure and maintain IT equipment and systems across site operations.
Gather and act on user feedback to continuously improve digital services and support delivery.
Contribute to regional and global IT projects and support vendors and contractors to ensure service delivery standards are met.
Prerequisites for your success in this role
Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a technology-related certification.
Broad knowledge of ITIL processes.
Knowledge of IT infrastructure, including laptops, mobile devices, video conferencing systems, and applications.
Proven experience in technical support, troubleshooting, and maintaining IT equipment and systems.
Familiarity with IT service management best practices and preventative maintenance strategies.
Solid skills in problem-solving and issue resolution, with the ability to apply practical judgement and continuous improvement techniques.
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools (Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to work across diverse teams and users.
A proactive approach with a focus on customer experience, teamwork, and service delivery excellence.
Your team and work environment
You will be part of the Digital function, working closely with site-based teams including Operations, HR, Finance, Safety, and end-users, as well as external vendors, contractors, and service providers.
This role operates in a dynamic and service-oriented environment where collaboration, responsiveness, and continuous improvement are critical to supporting site operations and ensuring seamless technology performance across the business.
This role is offered on a 21:21 day shift Fly in, Fly out (FIFO) roster to Lihir Island, Papua New Guinea.
Our FIFO employees stay in a secure and comfortable camp, in an en-suited and airconditioned room equipped with mini fridge, TV and Wi-Fi. A variety of healthy meal options are catered for at our mess; and the wet mess provides a relaxed social setting where employees can unwind with a game of pool or darts.
Why Join Newmont
At Newmont, you will be part of a global organisation committed to safety, innovation, and operational excellence.
We offer:
The opportunity to work within a high-performing and collaborative IT environment.
Exposure to diverse technologies and global systems supporting critical operations.
A strong culture of continuous improvement, learning, and development.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!
Submit your application through our website quoting reference number 42866 before the advertised closing date: 30 May 2026.

27137.description:
Hydrostatic Test Technician
Company Overview
MTIS Group is a highly equipped, specialized company providing engineering, commissioning, maintenance, procurement, and sales solutions across all major industrial sectors. With a core focus on integrity, communication, and cost reduction without compromising quality of service, we are dedicated to setting the standard in quality and support across our multidisciplinary range of services and products. Our main headquarters, service, and production facility is located in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea.
Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled and safety-focused Hydrostatic Test Technician to join our Calibration and Testing Department at our Motukea facility. Reporting to the Senior Calibration & Testing Technician, this hands-on workshop role is responsible for the safe and accurate pressure testing of hose assemblies, valves, pressure relief valves, pressure vessels, and other pressure-containing items, in accordance with company procedures and applicable industry standards.
Key Responsibilities
Hydrostatic testing of hydraulic, industrial, composite, and UHP hose assemblies.
Pressure and destructive testing of offshore floating hose assemblies.
Seat and shell pressure testing of valves.
Setting, adjustment, and testing of spring-loaded pressure relief valves.
Pressure testing of vessels, accumulators, and similar pressure-containing items.
Pneumatic pressure testing under direct supervision when required.
Test setup, isolation, air purging, and controlled pressurisation of items under test.
Accurate data logging and documentation of test parameters and results.
Calibration verification, care, and maintenance of all test equipment.
Workshop and laboratory support as required.
Adherence to HSE policies, procedures, and safety standards at all times.
Qualifications & Experience
Trade qualification in a mechanical, fitting, hydraulic, or related discipline preferred.
Demonstrated experience in pressure testing, valve servicing, or a comparable workshop environment.
Strong mechanical aptitude and a methodical, safety-first approach to work.
Clear understanding of the hazards of pressurised systems and stored energy.
Familiarity with relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO/IEC 17025, AS 1271, AS 3788, API 527) an advantage.
Ability to read and follow technical procedures and accurately complete test worksheets, with computer literacy in Excel and digital data-logging software.
Good written and verbal English, and the physical capability for workshop work.
Valid Driver's Licence an advantage.
Equal Opportunity Statement
MTIS Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We base our employment decisions on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, and performance, without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, or sexual orientation.

27041.description:
People & Culture Officer
PCS: People & Culture Services - Port Moresby, NCD
Job Title: People & Cultures Officer
Reports To: Head of People & Culture
Location: 11 Mile, Sogeri Road, Port Moresby, NCD
Employment Type: Full-Time
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 34 years. Today we are in one of the largest business schools in the country and off degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 11 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.
Our success is the fruits of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and future citizens on Papua New Guinea.
A CAREER WITH US:
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learned skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.
POSITION OVERVIEW
The People & Culture Officer is responsible for supporting the administrative and operational functions of the People & Culture Department, ensuring the smooth coordination of HR administration, employee records, payroll support, onboarding, employee welfare, and employee relations activities across the University.
The People & Culture Officer will play a key role in supporting daily HR operations while contributing to a positive, professional, and employee-focused work environment. This position requires a highly organized individual with strong interpersonal skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
The People & Culture Officer is expected to be a conceptual thinker with excellent organizational and time management skills. The person in this role must be reliable, able to follow instructions accurately, multitask effectively, and maintain confidentiality at all times.
Key Responsibilities

26683.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
This position is part of a team responsible for the implementation and maintenance of the mine power supply and distribution system for all electrical equipment on the mine and exploration sites in Kainantu.  In addition, this position will also play and important role in the training of trades assistants.
Key / Major Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Inspect, isolate, and repair electrical malfunctions using various hand and power tools.
Ensure that alarms and emergency electrical systems onsite are always operational.
Direct and train subordinates to install, maintain or repair electrical wiring, equipment, and machines.
Ensure and maintain safe work standards and practices in accordance with mine safety regulations for all tasks performed.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you are a NATTB certified electrician, with PPL certification and demonstrated experience within a mining / minerals processing environment. In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.
Experience in installation and maintenance of power distribution systems, transformer installations, motor control Centre’s, LV and HV transfers and starters.
The ability to fault find and develop appropriate solution in order to ensure the equipment availability is high.
Maintain current electrician’s license to meet government regulations.
Ability to train maintenance personnel in all aspects of their trade – particularly in diagnosis and fault finding, quality control, thoroughness and record keeping.
Must be a self-starter, and very resourceful, with the ability to find solutions to problems to ensure the equipment availability is high.
Good health physical ability is a prerequisite, as is the ability to live in a remote environment with limited facilities.
Flexible, adaptable and be a team player.
Life at K92
Our core values — Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Excellence, and Safety — are central to our operations and fundamental to our success. K92 upholds a commitment to equal opportunity, striving to ensure that every individual can reach their highest potential without experiencing discrimination.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
We believe in sharing our success with our employees. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer participation in long- and short-term incentive plans. We also offer savings programs, medical assistance, as well as access to our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
If you share our values and are looking for your next career step, come join us on this exciting journey. Submit your application through our website today.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

We are seeking to recruit a Mine Geologist to join the
Mine Technical Services – Geology Department
at Hidden Valley Mine. Reporting to the Senior Mine Geologist, the successful applicant will be responsible for delivering high-quality mine geology services to maximize resource recovery and minimize ore loss and dilution.
Key roles and responsibilities include:
Supervise grade control drilling programmes to accurately delineate ore ahead of mining
Supervise drilling contractors and ensure compliance with site safety standards, JSEAs and safe work procedures
Perform regular pit mapping and ensure timely incorporation of geological data into models
Supervise mine technicians to ensure accurate sampling, ore block mark-up and ore mining practices
Supervise ore mining activities to maximise recovery and minimise ore loss and dilution
Design, implement and supervise blast movement monitoring (BVI / OrePro)
Manage daily ROM stockpile blending to achieve planned mill feed grade targets
Liaise with Survey, Mining and Metallurgy teams to ensure correct ore placement and feed strategy
Compile and report daily and weekly ore mining production figures
Ensure grade control QAQC standards are met (sample weights, duplicates, field quality checks)
Participate in reconciliation processes (Reserve vs GC vs mined vs mill feed) and proactively flag risks
Conduct regular safety inspections of work areas and drill rigs
Actively participate in SBO, hazard identification, JSEA reviews and safety reporting. Adhere to site and department safe work procedures, including Environment Analysis (JSEA’s)
Provide training and mentoring to technicians and graduate geologists
Promote a strong safety, accountability and performance culture within the geology team
Qualifications, Skills and Experience required:
Bachelor Degree in Geology from a recognised higher institution
Minimum of 3 years’ experience in open pit mining
Strong understanding of grade control processes, ore loss & dilution controls and reconciliation principles
Proficiency with 3D mining software (Micromine preferred)
Experience with blast movement monitoring (BVI / OrePro) desirable
Strong data management and QAQC discipline
High level of computer literacy (Excel, reporting, databases)
Ability to communicate effectively with Mining, Survey and Metallurgy teams
Strong field leadership and safety mindset

27152.description:
Supervisor – Camps
About Us
New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high‑quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well‑being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions in which we operate. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact by fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.
NPL now has a vacancy for
Supervisor – Camps
within the Business Services Section of the Supply and Business Department.
About the Role
Reporting to the Superintendent- Camps, the incumbent will be responsible for the full delivery of accommodation services as well as supervision of contractors to ensure compliance in the delivery of catering, Janitorial and related services to all eligible residents of Porgera camp facilities. This position includes the supervision of staff, collation of data and presentation of reports relevant to effective Camp management.
In this role, you will:
Supervise daily Camps employee performances.
Ensure all camp facilities (accommodation, kitchen/mess, recreational areas) are operational and well maintained.
Manage /check all BS contractor invoices and ensure timely /efficient turnaround of invoices.
Provide back-up to Camps Superintendent as required.
Deliver an ongoing level of customer service that will meet or exceed expectations in all dealings with internal and external customers.
Use the In-flight software system for the management of all accommodation allocation, data and reports.
Use the SAP software system to submit work requests for any maintenance issues.
Ability to carry out scheduled inspections at the Camp Mess/s and report the findings.
Maintain stock control and inventory of all Camp items and order as necessary.
Maintain and update Paiam /Suyan Housing data.
Conduct Housing/Camp Accommodation inspection for maintenance requirements.
Maintain a high level of health and safety awareness and comply with the NPL Occupational Health & Safety Policy and all safety rules and procedures.
About You:
To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experiences:
Degree in Business Management, Tourism & Hospitality or relevant. College Certificate in relevant field will be preferred.
Ability to work unsupervised with a high level of supervisory skills.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in Catering and/or Camp Services.
Ability to work to critical deadlines and experience in cost management.
Advantage to have experience in use of Inflight / SAP software systems or similar for the management of accommodation data and reports.
Ability to communicate effectively across all levels.
Mobilization Requirement
This is a PNG National position, a site-based role on a FIFO arrangement with a rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Candidates must successfully pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening (to be arranged only for successful candidates after the interview stage), and provide an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months). Candidates must be PNG Nationals and available to start immediately. Females are encouraged to apply.
Join Our Team as a Supervisor -Camps
Embark on a rewarding career with New Porgera Limited as a Supervisor - Camps. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a dynamic team to contribute to NPL’s success. Enjoy a balanced work schedule, competitive compensation, and a chance to develop your career and technical expertise in a supportive and professional environment.
Note:
This advert will be open until
29th May 2026
. If you do not hear from NPL within next two (2) weeks following the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful for this opportunity.

27147.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Purpose
The Advisor Power & Utilities Operations will support operations team in P&U to ensure efficiency and compliance with safety standards.
Essential Duties
Adhere to daily P&U operations
Execute strategies to enhance operational efficiency
Support, collaborate with, and provide assistance to Supervisors P&U Operations
Assess data and report on improvement outcomes
Administer safety protocols and execute regular safety audits
Responsible for assessing relevant risks, executing mitigation measures, and continuously monitoring for risks
Provide technical expertise and support for operational troubleshooting
Produce weekly High-Level Plan (HLP) for execution.
Engauge in weekly planning meetings.
Training & Experience
A commitment to Safety
Relevant academic qualification or trade qualification in Power Generation, Practical knowledge gained from working in relevant Power Station roles - applied knowledge of technical aspects of the role including Power systems, equipment and systems
Practical and applied knowledge of working safely and sustainably in this area of Power generation.
Proven ability to identify risk and taking active steps to mitigate risk
Acquired knowledge of business and process improvement identifying improvement opportunity and taking appropriate action
Competent in safety, health, and sustainability
Knowledge in operation of boiler and steam systems is an advantage.
Knowledge in Heavy Fuel Oil separators operations is an advantage.
Knowledge in Demineralising operation for producing Boiler water is an advantage
Working Conditions
This is a 21/21 FIFO roster.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!
Apply

Job Title: Construction Site Engineer
Reports To: Projects Manager
Department: Campus and Facilities Management                                                                                    Location: IBSUniversity, Mt. Eriama, 11 Mile Campus
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS) began its journey in 1987 as a modest initiative under Nades & Associates, primarily offering revision classes to support the needs of the Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants, now known as CPA PNG. Over the past 36 years, IBS has grown steadily into a private university-level institution. Today, IBS is recognised as one of the largest business schools in Papua New Guinea, offering degree programmes in Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies, and Information Technology. In addition, the institution continues to provide academic pathways for Grade 10 and 12 school leavers, as well as industry-recognised certification opportunities for experienced professionals seeking formal qualifications in their respective fields. This success has been made possible through the dedication and commitment of our team, whose collective efforts continue to make a meaningful contribution to Papua New Guinea by helping to educate and empower both current and future citizens.
A CAREER WITH US:
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learnt skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but also enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.
ABOUT THIS ROLE:
Construction Site Engineer will be responsible for overseeing all the activities on the construction site. The Construction Site Engineer ensures that projects are completed on time, with a budget, and our client’s specifications. This includes planning, coordinating, and supervising onsite functions, staffing, scheduling, and material control.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Execution of site work—Directing, executing, consulting, monitoring, quality controlling, and punch listing (rectifications) of relevant Civil Engineering construction works including earthwork, drainage work, road construction, and building construction (concrete and steel) along with incidental construction (curb laying, paving Interlocking concrete blocks, etc.).
Workplace Communications- Methods applicable to target groups, providing specific information to workers about their safety and developing team performances, commitment, and corporation.
Technical supervision during construction - Assess performances according to approved plans and drawings and consult the manager/professionals for any predicted problems and changes in the ongoing construction.
Supervise construction projects to ensure they are completed in line with the scope, time, budget, and set quality standards.
Ensure all work complies with building codes and safety regulations.
Inspect project sites regularly to identify and eliminate potential safety hazards.
Supervising and instructing the construction team as well as subcontractors
Communicating with clients’ suppliers, and laborers effectively
Prepare and submit progress reports.
Ensuring the quality of materials and workmanship meet specified standards and codes.
Manage the procurement of materials, machinery, tools and equipment necessary for the project.
Resolving conflicts or miscommunication that may happen onsite quickly and amicably.
Education and Qualification
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 5 years’ proven experience in a similar role.
In-depth knowledge of construction procedures, equipment, OSHA guidelines, and project management principles
Excellent organizational, leadership and management skills
Ability to communicate and report effectively.
Aptitude in Math and strong problem-solving skills
Good physical condition and stamina
Current state licensure for contacting or similar, if required
Exceptional attention to detail with an ability to spot potential risks or issues before they arise.

27142.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Purpose
The FE Maintenance Advisor is the senior technical authority. responsible for overseeing the entire work management process to ensure maintenance activities are prioritised, planned, scheduled, and executed to the highest standard. This role provides leadership to Technical Advisors & Supervisors governs the quality of work management data, and ensures maintenance strategies, materials readiness, and schedule commitments are met. The Advisor drives continuous improvement through analysis of performance trends, BI insights, and equipment reliability indicators. Acting as a key support to the Maintenance Superintendent—this position plays a vital part in ensuring operational continuity, technical excellence, and long term equipment health.
Essential Duties
Senior technical and work-management authority
End to end work management & technical governance.
Workflow (identify → plan → schedule → execute → analyse), prioritisation, plan approval, schedule sequencing, data oversight.
Defines strategic maintenance tasks (PMs, inspections).
Reviews and endorses plans.
Verifies priority, materials, labour, tooling, permits, and planning accuracy.
Ensures schedule is technically achievable.
Verifies resource leveling, materials, equipment availability, and timelines.
QA/QC, escalation point for technical issues.
Validates complex work quality and procedural compliance.
Reviews completion quality.
Ensures follow ups and corrective tasks are raised properly.
Owns KPI review, BI insights, strategy changes, and improvement plans.
Modifies strategic tasks based on performance.
Leads the Technical Advisors & Supervisors.
Supports and acts for the Maintenance Superintendent.
Maintains technical and work management governance.
Training & Experience
Bachelor Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
5 to 10 years mining experience in a similar role within the mining industry
Experience with crushing conveyors, grinding mills and large slurry pumps
A personal commitment to safety
Working Conditions
This is a FIFO role on a 21/21 roster.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!
Apply

27112.description:
Advisor – HR Business Partner
About Us
New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.
The New Porgera Limited now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual to join our Human Resources Department as
Advisor – HR Business Partner.
About the role
We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded HR Business Partner to join our dynamic Human Resources team supporting a large-scale mining operation. This is an exciting opportunity for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced operational environments and is passionate about building strong workforce capability, culture, and leadership across a remote mining workforce.
Reporting to the HR Manager, the HR Business Partner will partner closely with operational leaders to deliver practical people solutions that support safe, productive, and high-performing operations and HR Business Strategies.
In this role, you will:
Partner with operational leaders to provide strategic and day-to-day HR support across site operations
Support workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, and employee development initiatives
Drive employee engagement, culture, and leadership capability across operational teams
Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, site procedures, and HR governance standards
Assist with organisational change, restructuring, and continuous improvement initiatives
Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention strategies for remote workforce operations
Provide advice and guidance on employee relations, industrial relations, performance management, investigations, and disciplinary matters
Analyse workforce trends and provide reporting and insights to site leadership
Ensure compensation and benefits policies comply with PNG Labor Laws, Mining industry regulations internal governance policies
Promote a strong safety culture aligned with company values and operational standards
Maintain a high level of health, safety and environmental awareness and comply with all relevant NPL policies & procedures.
About You
To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experiences:
Tertiary qualifications in Human Resources, Business, or a related discipline will be highly regarded
Previous experience in a HR Business Partner, Senior HR Advisor, or equivalent operational HR role
Excellent communication, coaching, and influencing skills
Experience working within mining, resources, construction, heavy industry, or other operational environments
Highly developed computer skills including Microsoft excel, PowerPoint and other MS Office applications
Detail oriented and a track record of delivering projects end-to-end
Strong employee and industrial relations capability, including investigations and case management
Ability to build trusted relationships with frontline leaders and senior stakeholders
Strong understanding of employment legislation and HR best practices
High resilience, adaptability, and ability to work effectively in remote site environments.
Mobilization Requirement
This is a PNG National position, a site-based role on a FIFO arrangement with a rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Candidates must successfully pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening (to be arranged only for successful candidates after the interview stage), and provide an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months). Candidates must be PNG Nationals and available to start immediately. Females are encouraged to apply.
Join Our Team as an Advisor – HR Business Partner
Embark on a rewarding career with NPL as an Advisor – HR Business Partner. This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a dynamic team to contribute to NPL’s success. 26462.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
In this role you will administer our employee technical training programs as we seek to develop our national staff in a range of areas specifically mobile equipment operation. You will ensure that these programs meet K92 Mining standards and external training accreditation where necessary.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Deliver technical and non-technical training as directed, ensuring alignment and compliance with the Technical Training Standard (HR-ST-701).
Assist department Trainers with maintenance of Training Needs Analysis and training planning activities.
Administer Safetrac training, including updating records, tracking compliance rates and production of reports.
Assist with scheduling of training for non-technical training programs.
Support delivery of School to Mine programs and Wellness Programs on site.
Assist with administration and management of training documents for HR Department.
Monitor training provided for personnel and develop effective training materials, evaluations and record keeping systems consistent with existing site document control.
Ensure accurate training records are maintained.
Actively promote a safe and healthy culture.
Ensure all K92 safety standards, policies & procedures are always adhered to
Ensure compliance with all legislative, company, and personal HSE systems.
Assist in delivery of site-based training to ensure compliance with HSE and alignment with Mandatory Training (HR-FM-701) and Induction Training (HR-FM-702).
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Certificate IV in Workplace Training.
Valid Class 7 PNG license
A minimum of 4 years’ experience in a training delivery role preference in mining and/or construction industry.
Evidence of previous experience on relevant machinery.
Well-developed computer skills with competence in MS Office Suite.
Desirable experience in Pronto, SAP, Safetrac recordkeeping systems.
Well-developed interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills in English
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

27145.description:
Work on critical power generation infrastructure
Strong safety culture and supportive team environment
Career growth in a dynamic energy operations setting
Our client is a growing organisation operating within Papua New Guinea’s energy and utilities sector, committed to delivering reliable operational performance through innovation, safety, and technical excellence.
The company offers a supportive and team-oriented environment where employees are empowered to contribute to critical infrastructure projects while developing their technical capability and long-term careers. With a strong focus on safety, operational integrity, and continuous improvement, this is an excellent opportunity to join a business that values professionalism, accountability, and collaboration.
We are currently seeking an experienced Electrical & Instrumentation Technician to support the safe and efficient operation and maintenance of plant equipment and systems within a power generation environment. This role will play a key part in ensuring equipment reliability, minimizing downtime, and maintaining compliance with operational and safety standards.
Key Responsibilities
Carry out routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on electrical and instrumentation systems
Monitor and maintain plant equipment including turbines, generators, compressors, motors, and control systems
Conduct inspections, fault finding, and diagnostic testing to identify equipment issues
Support preventive maintenance programs to improve operational reliability and efficiency
Ensure compliance with workplace safety procedures, permits, and lock out/tag out requirements
Maintain accurate maintenance records, reports, and equipment documentation
Key Requirements
Minimum 5 years’ experience within power generation, electrical, controls, or industrial maintenance environments
Strong technical knowledge of electrical and instrumentation systems and equipment
Experience working with high voltage switchgear, generators, turbines, or plant control systems will be highly regarded
Ability to interpret electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation
Sound understanding of workplace health, safety, and compliance requirements
Strong communication skills with the ability to work independently and within a team environment
This is an exciting opportunity for a technically capable and safety-focused professional seeking to join a dynamic operational environment. If you are looking to further develop your career within the energy sector, we encourage you to apply.

Job Summary
The purpose of the Quality Management Systems Officer Position is to assist the HSES&Q Coordinator in ensuring that KutMor’s quality management system is effectively implemented and maintained. The QMS Officer will play a crucial role in QMS documentation, identifying areas for improvement, implementing corrective actions, and promoting a culture of quality within the organisation. We are seeking to recruit for the position of
APD Operations Supervisor
for our
Safety, Health, Security & Risk – Asset Protection
Department. Reporting to the APD Superintendent, the primary objective for this role is to supervise the Asset Protection Department Operations in order to comply with all policies and procedures as they pertain to the security of the company’s personnel and infrastructures.
This role will be offered as a National FIFO/DIDO opportunity within Papua New Guinea working on a 16/12 roster.
Key roles and responsibilities include:
Ensure compliance to the Hidden Valley Security Management Plan and lead physical asset protection and security risk management activities
Assist in driving operational excellence in security and asset protection management practices through proactive engagement, guidance and support to the site.
Provide technical advice, coaching, guidance, and mentoring to security and asset protection personnel and security contractor(s).
Identify and recommend best practice initiatives to improve asset protection and security preparedness and response and capabilities
Application of the four basic pillars for asset protection and security; Deterrence, Detection, Delay and Response, and the underpinning requirements / controls for effectiveness.
Oversee incident response planning inclusive of intelligence collection and investigation of security breaches. Assist with disciplinary matters associated with such breaches as necessary.
Ensure completion of daily activities and ensure security is deployed and effective to plan.
Maintain training plans and competency matrices for all security and asset protection personnel.
Conduct security drills and exercises to ensure effective security preparedness and response capabilities
Ensure completion of routine inspections, testing and scheduling of maintenance for asset protection and security equipment
Command and control of the day-to-day management of all Asset Protection Officers and contracted Security Guards
Ensure ongoing implementation, effectiveness, understanding and compliance of Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights training by all Asset Protection Officers and contracted Security Guards.
Monitor the performance and development of the Asset Protection Team, oversee recruitment decisions, applying performance management practices and implementing training programs.
Ensure own behaviour is aligned with the Company Values at all times and inspire others to align with this framework also.
Remain abreast of key industry / regulatory developments at all times.
Qualifications, Skills and Experience required:
Minimum 5 years industry experience with previous leadership experience
Police or military background or security industry background in similar role
Ability to lead up front, mentor and motivate subordinates
Participated in Basic Security Trainings/Courses
Strong communication skills, both oral & written
Have intermediate computer skills in MS Word
Able to speak and understand Tok Pisin, and read, write and speak well in English
Possess valid and current PNG class 6 driving license
Strong planning and organizing skills, with the ability to be assertive

Credit Corporation PNG is recruiting a suitable candidate for the role of
Network Engineer.
As a Network Engineer specialising in Cisco and Fortinet technologies, the successful candidate will play a critical role in our IT infrastructure and network team. He/she will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing robust network solutions that ensure high availability, security, and performance.
Primary Responsibilities:
Network Monitoring and Maintenance:
Configure routers, switches, and firewalls to ensure optimal performance and security.
Conduct regular maintenance and upgrades of network hardware and software.
Monitor system performance, call quality, and network traffic related to CUCM.
Implement and manage security protocols using Fortinet products, including firewall configurations and VPN setups.
Monitor network performance using tools and metrics to identify issues and areas for improvement.
Diagnose and resolve network-related issues across local and remote locations.
Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability scans to ensure compliance with best practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with IT team members on projects and initiatives that require network support.
Provide training and support to staff on network usage, best practices, and security awareness.
Liaise with vendors for procurement, support, and maintenance of network equipment and services.
Maintain relationships with service providers to ensure optimal service delivery.
Disaster Recovery Planning:
Create specific recovery strategies for critical network components, including routers, switches, firewalls, and servers.
Develop and implement disaster recovery plans to ensure network continuity in case of outages or failures.
Test and update recovery procedures regularly.
Ensure failover systems and alternate routes are in place and tested.
Documentation & Knowledge Management:
Maintain detailed documentation of network configurations and changes.
Contribute to the knowledge base to improve team efficiency and service quality.
Monitor network usage and plan for capacity to ensure scalability.
Change Management:
Participate in change management processes to minimise risk during upgrades and deployments.
Assess the impact of network changes on services and infrastructure.
Work with cross-functional teams to improve network services.
Participate in post-incident reviews to identify areas for improvement.

Experience in configuring and managing Fortinet firewalls and other Fortinet security products.
Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) for voice and video solutions.

Seeking a recently qualified aspirational professional looking to grow
Job Title
Feasibility Architect / Concept Design Lead (RIBA Stages 0–2)
Papua New Guinea (Remote / Hybrid / Project-Based)
This role is focused on
speed, clarity, and commercial intelligence at the front end of the design process
, rather than detailed technical delivery or construction documentation.
You will be working closely with development and investment stakeholders to rapidly translate site opportunities into clear, test-fit driven design strategies that inform go/no-go decisions.
Site analysis and constraint mapping
High-level development appraisals
Test fits and yield/density studies
Concept massing and early-stage design options
Visualisation support for internal investment decisions
Key Responsibilities
Rapidly assess new development sites and prepare feasibility studies
Produce concise project briefs based on planning, site, and commercial constraints
Develop test-fit layouts, area schedules, and early yield calculations
Create massing models, sketch concepts, and 3D studies
Produce quick, clear visual outputs (SketchUp / Rhino / Revit conceptual level)
Iterate designs quickly based on cost, planning, and strategy inputs
Communicate clearly with non-design stakeholders including developers and investors
Support investment decision-making through visual and analytical outputs
Manage multiple feasibility studies concurrently under tight timeframes
Key Requirements
Architecture qualification (or equivalent recognised experience)
Strong experience working within
RIBA Stages 0–2 (or equivalent concept/pre-planning stages)
Demonstrated experience in
development-led or feasibility architecture work
Strong commercial understanding of:
Yield and density
Buildability constraints
Development economics (basic to intermediate level)
Highly proficient in:
SketchUp and/or Rhino
Concept-level Revit (or equivalent BIM awareness)
Fast rendering / visualisation tools (Enscape, Lumion, V-Ray, etc.)
Ability to work quickly and iteratively with incomplete information
Strong communication skills, particularly with non-technical stakeholders
Highly organised and able to manage multiple parallel studies
Important Regulatory Note.
This role involves early-stage design and feasibility work only.
To legally act as the
registered architect of record in Papua New Guinea
, local professional registration is required.
This position does
not require registration to perform concept, feasibility, or pre-design services
, as all statutory documentation and sign-off will be undertaken by a locally registered architect where required.
We welcome applications from internationally qualified architects with relevant experience.

26708.description:
Job Type:
Fixed Term Contract
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
The Safety Officer for Projects is responsible for ensuring that all safety regulations and procedures are followed during the execution of the stage 3 expansion for Kainantu Gold Mine. This role is a crucial role in preventing accidents and incidents, protecting the health and safety of employees, contractors and maintaining compliance with Papua New Guinea’s safety laws and regulations.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensuring the continuous improvement of, safety inspections, safety training and compliance.
Maintain a safe work environment for all K92 employees, visitors and contractors through audits, inspections, and training.
Maintain the efficiency and cost-effective management of safety in the workplace and project site.
Ensure all incidents are fully investigated and recorded within the site safety data base in a timely and accurate manner.
Conduct safety training programs and initiative.
Conduct scheduled, weekly, monthly safety audits and checks project wide
Collate and submit weekly and monthly reports to Project Director and Operational GM.
Attend site wide weekly and monthly safety meetings.
Ensuring that the camp and project sites safety regulations are observed by all K92 employees including contractors,
Provide safety induction to new intakes, casuals, contractors, and visitors to site.
To ensure the safety rules and other policies of the camp and mine site are observed and report any suspicious activities.
About You
To be considered for this position, candidates must have 10 years minimum Safety work experience in an extractive industry or heavy construction environment. In addition to this, candidates should also (ideally) be able to demonstrate some or all the following.
Appropriate Safety Officer qualifications (Cert IV OHS minimum).
Significant experience with auditing, incident reporting.
Incident investigation training (preferably ICAM)
Well versed with safety systems that deals with compliance records and reports.
Excellent oral and written communications skills.
Very good end user of MS Office Suite: Word, Excel and Outlook.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

Parts Supervisor
SPECTRA LAE IS HIRING!
Spectra Industrial Limited - a Leader in Sales, Service and Hire of Forklifts, Gensets and Industrial Supplies, is seeking organized and well experienced individuals to join our Lae Spare Parts Team and be a part of our growing enterprise!
Position Description
Position Title: Parts Supervisor
Company: Spectra Industrial Ltd
Location: Lae, Papua New Guinea
Reports To: National Parts and Inventory Manager
Position Purpose
The Parts Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily operation of the parts department to ensure the accurate identification, sourcing, supply, and control of parts for forklifts, heavy equipment, and related machinery. This role provides leadership and direction to the parts and warehouse team while ensuring efficient inventory management, timely support to workshop operations, and high levels of customer service to minimize equipment downtime and support overall operational performance.
Key Responsibilities
Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of the parts department and warehouse operations.
Lead and support parts personnel to ensure accurate and timely identification, sourcing, and supply of parts.
Interpret parts catalogues, service manuals, and technical documentation to ensure correct parts are supplied.
Monitor inventory levels and ensure stock control procedures are followed.
Coordinate with suppliers and management to ensure timely procurement and delivery of required parts.
Oversee the processing of parts orders, invoices, requisitions, and related documentation.
Ensure all parts transactions and inventory movements are accurately recorded within company systems.
Provide technical guidance and support to workshop teams regarding parts compatibility and equipment requirements.
Assist with staff training and development within the parts and warehouse department.
Identify opportunities to improve parts processes, inventory systems, and operational efficiencies.
Ensure the department maintains a clean, safe, and organized working environment.
Support the National Parts and Inventory Manager with reporting, planning, and operational oversight.
Key Competencies & Skills
Strong leadership and supervisory capability within a parts or warehouse environment.
Advanced ability to read and interpret parts catalogues, service manuals, and technical documentation.
Computer literate with experience using inventory and parts management systems.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Mechanical knowledge and technical understanding of forklifts and heavy equipment.
Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
Strong focus on customer service, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Qualifications & Experience
Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar role within the heavy equipment, automotive, or industrial equipment industry.
Previous supervisory or team leadership experience preferred.
Sound knowledge of mechanical components, particularly forklifts and heavy machinery.
Proven experience in interpreting technical manuals and parts catalogues.
Experience in inventory control and warehouse operations.
Formal training or certification in mechanics, automotive parts interpretation, supply chain, or related discipline is desirable.
Workplace Relationships
Internal: Workshop teams, Service Technicians, Workshop & Engineering Manager, Administration staff, Warehouse personnel.
External: Suppliers, manufacturers, freight providers, and customers as required.
Performance Indicators
Accuracy and efficiency of parts identification and supply.
Inventory accuracy and effective stock control management.
Timeliness in sourcing and supplying parts to support workshop operations.
Effective supervision and coordination of the parts department team.
Reduction in equipment downtime through efficient parts support.
Compliance with company procedures, inventory controls, and reporting requirements.
Positive communication and collaboration with workshop teams, suppliers, and management.

Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby
Holiday Inn Express Port Moresby
At Holiday Inn, we’re all about making travel easier and more enjoyable for our guests — and that starts with the people who bring our brand to life. If you’re a relationship-builder, a natural connector, and someone who loves driving commercial results while keeping things genuine and human, we’d love to meet you.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a passionate, service-driven, and results-oriented Rooms Division Manager to lead and oversee the day-to-day operations of our Rooms Division departments. This role is responsible for ensuring exceptional guest experiences across Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Services, and Duty Management while driving operational excellence, team engagement, and financial performance.
The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment, is highly organized, guest-focused, and committed to delivering brand standards and operational consistency.

Lead and manage the Front Office, Housekeeping, Concierge, Guest Services, and Duty Management teams.

Monitor room inventory, occupancy, arrivals, departures, and VIP movements.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the Rooms Division.
Champion exceptional guest service and create memorable guest experiences.

Ability to lead under pressure and make sound decisions.

26709.description:
Job Type:
Fixed Term Contract
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
The Safety Officer for Projects is responsible for ensuring that all safety regulations and procedures are followed during the execution of the stage 3 expansion for Kainantu Gold Mine. This role is a crucial role in preventing accidents and incidents, protecting the health and safety of employees, contractors and maintaining compliance with Papua New Guinea’s safety laws and regulations.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Ensuring the continuous improvement of, safety inspections, safety training and compliance.
Maintain a safe work environment for all K92 employees, visitors and contractors through audits, inspections, and training.
Maintain the efficiency and cost-effective management of safety in the workplace and project site.
Ensure all incidents are fully investigated and recorded within the site safety data base in a timely and accurate manner.
Conduct safety training programs and initiative.
Conduct scheduled, weekly, monthly safety audits and checks project wide
Collate and submit weekly and monthly reports to Project Director and Operational GM.
Attend site wide weekly and monthly safety meetings.
Ensuring that the camp and project sites safety regulations are observed by all K92 employees including contractors,
Provide safety induction to new intakes, casuals, contractors, and visitors to site.
To ensure the safety rules and other policies of the camp and mine site are observed and report any suspicious activities.
About You
To be considered for this position, candidates must have 10 years minimum Safety work experience in an extractive industry or heavy construction environment. In addition to this, candidates should also (ideally) be able to demonstrate some or all the following.
Appropriate Safety Officer qualifications (Cert IV OHS minimum).
Significant experience with auditing, incident reporting.
Incident investigation training (preferably ICAM)
Well versed with safety systems that deals with compliance records and reports.
Excellent oral and written communications skills.
Very good end user of MS Office Suite: Word, Excel and Outlook.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply
